evals.name: beside-prd
evals.prompt: /specs:nfr book swaps: what quality targets do we need? Draft it, I'll review.
evals.expected_output: docs/specs/book-swaps/nfr.md beside the PRD: NFR- rows each with a number, a Verified by from the four allowed values, scoped to FR- IDs, a Traces to row linking prd.md, guesses as Assumed:, under 400 words, no stack.
assertions: NFR file written beside the PRD
Exactly one file written, nothing else changed
Under 400 words
Every requirement is measurable (a number, or a pass/fail rule)
Every requirement says how it is verified (Scenario, Load test, Monitoring, Review)
Requirements are scoped to FR- IDs
Traces to row links the PRD next to it
Guesses listed as Assumed: under Open questions
Reported word count matches wc -w
No implementation detail from the README's stack
Reported the path back to the user (notes.md)
Not committed

evals.name: update-keeps-ids
evals.prompt: /specs:nfr --path docs/specs/book-swaps/nfr.md borrow requests should reach the owner within 1 minute, not 5. Drop NFR-2, the platform availability target covers it now. And add one for the 30-day reminders (FR-6): they shouldn't go missing.
evals.expected_output: nfr.md updated in place: NFR-1 now says 1 minute, NFR-2 struck through with a reason, NFR-3 unchanged, the reminder target added as NFR-4 with a number, a Verified by value and an Assumed: entry, nothing renumbered, Last updated bumped; the reply warns that ADR 0004 relies on the 5-minute target.
assertions: NFR file written beside the PRD
Exactly one file written, nothing else changed
NFR-1 tightened to 1 minute
NFR-2 struck through with a reason, not deleted or reused
NFR-3 unchanged
Reminder requirement added as NFR-4, scoped to FR-6
Every requirement is measurable (a number, or a pass/fail rule)
Every requirement says how it is verified (Scenario, Load test, Monitoring, Review)
Guesses listed as Assumed: under Open questions
Last updated bumped
Warned that ADR 0004 cites the tightened NFR-1
No implementation detail from the README's stack
Reported the path back to the user (notes.md)
Not committed
